"""Generate the 5 s RGB clip for the stationary rubber-duck tabletop scene.

The prompt describes a locked-off, fixed-frame, real-time shot in which the
yellow rubber duck and the wooden table are stationary against a plain
background and no action occurs. The faithful, temporally consistent result is
therefore a constant video: every frame repeats the supplied first frame.
"""
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

import artifact_io


CASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
FRAMES = 20
HEIGHT = 144
WIDTH = 256


def main() -> None:
    first = np.array(Image.open(CASE_DIR / "first_frame.png").convert("RGB"))
    assert first.shape == (HEIGHT, WIDTH, 3), first.shape
    assert first.dtype == np.uint8

    # Stationary locked-off shot: hold the first frame for the full 5 seconds.
    frames = np.repeat(first[None, ...], FRAMES, axis=0)
    assert frames.shape == (FRAMES, HEIGHT, WIDTH, 3)

    artifact_io.save(frames, CASE_DIR)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
